Execute.SQL: UPDATE VALIDATION_ERROR E SET ERROR_MESSAGE_DELIVERED = cast(to_timestamp(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AS DATE) WHERE ERROR_MESSAGE_DELIVERED is null AND PF_SOURCE_CLIENT LIKE 'R1_%'

SELECT E.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, E.POLNUMBER, E.ERROR_DATE, E.REQ_CODE_TC, E.REQ_CODE_TXT, E.REASON_FOR_ERROR FROM VALIDATION_ERROR E WHERE ERROR_MESSAGE_DELIVERED = cast(to_timestamp(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AS DATE) AND E.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT LIKE 'R1_%' ORDER BY E.ERROR_DATE DESC
